# Server test fixtures

- `off/`: real Open Food Facts API responses recorded on 2026-11-19 with
  `scripts/record_off_fixtures.py` (4 barcodes: 3 found, 1 not found). Data © Open Food Facts
  contributors, [ODbL 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). No personal data: the
  contact email travels only in the request User-Agent, which is not recorded.
